validate-r4.cljs.utf8:
(require '[antigravity.extern.host :as host]
         '[antigravity.infra.review :as infra]
         '[antigravity.law.review :as law]
         '[antigravity.shape.stream :as stream]
         '[antigravity.shape.finish :as finish]
         '[antigravity.shape.diff :as diff]
         '[clojure.string :as str])
(let [[directory repo] *command-line-args*
      read-json (fn [name] (host/parse-json (host/read-text (host/join directory name))))
      input (read-json "input.json") payload (read-json "input.txt")
      events (host/native-lines (host/read-text (host/join directory "native.stdout.json")))
      native (stream/terminal events) init (:init (first events))
      schema (read-json "result.schema.json")
      shaped (finish/split-output (:structured_output native))
      canonical (infra/text-patch! repo (:base input) (:head input) [])
      merge-bases (str/split-lines (str/trim (host/git! repo ["merge-base" "--all" (:base_tip input) (:head input)] 65536)))
      text (host/read-text (host/join directory "input.txt"))
      prompt (infra/prompt payload text (host/read-text (host/join directory "result.schema.json")))
      stdin (str (host/compact-json (stream/user-message prompt)) "\n")
      invocation (read-json "invocation.json")
      entries (vec (sort-by :path (infra/parse-raw (host/git! repo ["diff" "--raw" "-z" "--no-abbrev" "--no-renames" (:base input) (:head input) "--"] 1048576))))
      blob-errors (mapcat (fn [entry supplied metadata]
                            (concat
                              (when-not (= entry (select-keys supplied (keys entry))) [:git-blob-binding])
                              (for [[side oid-key content-key bytes-key hash-key]
                                    [[:base :base-oid :base-content :base-bytes :base-sha256]
                                     [:head :head-oid :head-content :head-bytes :head-sha256]]
                                    :let [blob (host/blob! repo (get entry oid-key) (:file-bytes law/limits))]
                                    :when (not (and (= blob (get supplied content-key))
                                                    (= (host/bytes blob) (get metadata bytes-key))
                                                    (= (host/sha256 blob) (get metadata hash-key))))]
                                [:incomplete-blob (:path entry) side]))) entries (:files payload) (:files input))
      changed (into {} (map (fn [path]
                             [path (diff/added-lines (infra/text-patch! repo (:base input) (:head input) [path]))]) (:paths input)))
      errors (concat (law/input-errors input)
                     (law/envelope-errors {:cwd (:cwd init) :schema schema} events)
                     (when-not (= :shaped (:status shaped)) [shaped])
                     (law/result-errors input changed (:review shaped))
                     blob-errors
                     (when-not (= [(:base input)] merge-bases) [:canonical-unique-base])
                     (when-not (= (:base_tip input) (:base_tip payload) (:base_tip invocation)) [:base-tip-binding])
                     (when-not (= (:prompt-sha256 input) (host/sha256 prompt)) [:prompt-digest])
                     (when-not (= (:stdin-sha256 input) (host/sha256 stdin) (:stdin-sha256 invocation)) [:stdin-digest])
                     (when-not (and (= (:prompt-bytes input) (host/bytes prompt))
                                    (= (:stdin-bytes input) (host/bytes stdin))) [:transport-byte-counts])
                     (when-not (every? (fn [[_ before after]] (= (count (:base input)) (count before) (count after)))
                                       (re-seq #"(?m)^index ([0-9a-f]+)\.\.([0-9a-f]+)" canonical)) [:full-index])
                     (when-not (= (:paths input) (mapv :path entries)) [:canonical-paths])
                     (when-not (= canonical (:diff payload)) [:canonical-diff-bytes])
                     (when-not (= (:diff_digest input) (host/sha256 canonical)) [:canonical-diff-digest])
                     (when-not (= (:input-sha256 input) (host/sha256 (host/read-text (host/join directory "input.txt")))) [:input-digest])
                     (when-not (= (:paths input) (mapv :path (:files payload))) [:payload-scope]))]
  (println (host/json {:errors (vec errors) :base (:base input) :base_tip (:base_tip input) :head (:head input)
                       :diff_digest (:diff_digest input) :status (:status (:review shaped))
                       :findings (:findings (:review shaped)) :reviewed_paths (:reviewed_paths (:review shaped))
                       :native_duration_seconds (:duration_seconds native) :num_turns (:num_turns native)
                       :event_count (count events) :native_permission_mode (:permission_mode init)}))
  (host/exit-code! (if (seq errors) 1 0)))
